facts.summary: Initial dose-escalation data showed limited efficacy (2 of 6 pancreatic responses) · Phase 1a · CX-904 in advanced solid tumors · not yet approved
facts.indication: advanced metastatic solid tumors (EGFR-expressing), incl. pancreatic cancer

evidence.summary: Encouraging initial signs of efficacy observed for CX-904 in advanced pancreatic cancer, including 2 of 6 patients (33%) with a confirmed partial response and all 6 patients (100%) with disease control
evidence.safety: CX-904 demonstrated a favorable safety profile that supports administration and monitoring of enrolled patients in an outpatient setting.
evidence.program_discontinued: CX-904 Phase 1a dose escalation and optimization continue
